$comment: Certification registry — sourced only from official credential pages (officialSource ids → sources.json). Volatile fields (exam codes, prices, dates) carry verifiedAt; re-verify before advising a learner. Status: current | beta | retiring | retired | unverified.

aws-ai-practitioner.name: AWS Certified AI Practitioner
aws-ai-practitioner.audience: Business and technical roles new to AI/ML on AWS
aws-ai-practitioner.delivery: proctored exam, test center or online
aws-ai-practitioner.volatile: Price, exam code, and domain weights change — verify on the official page before registering.
aws-ai-practitioner.prerequisites: None — entry-level; AWS recommends familiarity with AI concepts
aws-ai-practitioner.renewal: Valid 3 years; recertify via current exam
aws-ai-practitioner.officialPrep: AWS Skill Builder official prep path

aws-ml-engineer-associate.prerequisites: AWS recommends ~1 year of ML/AI experience on AWS
aws-ml-engineer-associate.renewal: Valid 3 years; recertify via current exam
aws-ml-engineer-associate.officialPrep: AWS Skill Builder official prep path
